title: All rooms should span every hostel, with a hostel filter, and move to the Property tab
description: Product Owner request, three changes to All rooms: show rooms across all hostels rather than only the selected one; add a filter to narrow to a hostel; and move the entry point to the Property tab. CURRENT STATE: AllRoomsViewModel takes a hostelId from the nav route and queries getByHostelIdWithFloor(hostelId), so the screen is hostel-scoped by construction. Reaching it means Property > pick a hostel > All rooms, which is exactly the drill-down LODGY-40 set out to remove - it just removed one level of it rather than two. Widening the query and adding a filter finishes that job. IMPLEMENTATION NOTES: the repository needs an all-hostels equivalent of getByHostelIdWithFloor, and the room rows need to carry their hostel so tiles can be grouped or labelled - a room number alone is ambiguous once two properties are on screen, since both can have a 101. The occupancy flow observeRoomOccupancyByHostel is likewise per-hostel and needs the same widening. The RAG tiles and summary from LODGY-67 carry over unchanged; the summary should follow the filter rather than always reporting the whole estate. OPEN QUESTION for the PO: with the screen no longer hostel-scoped, whether the hostel-level 'All rooms' action disappears entirely or stays as a shortcut that opens the screen pre-filtered to that hostel. The second keeps the useful path from a hostel you are already inside.
acceptanceCriteria: All rooms lists rooms from every hostel by default, not only the selected one
A hostel filter narrows the view, including an all-hostels option, and the empty/part-full/full summary reflects the current filter rather than the whole estate
Each tile identifies which hostel its room belongs to, so two properties with a room 101 are not confusable
The screen is reachable directly from the Property tab without first opening a hostel
Tapping a tile still opens that room's bed grid regardless of which hostel it is in
Correct in dark mode and in Hindi, and the tiles stay legible once a hostel name is added to them
A warden with a single hostel sees no regression - the filter is unobtrusive and the screen still reads as it does today

history.note: Filed at the Product Owner's request: All rooms should span every hostel with a hostel filter, and move to the Property tab. Notes which repository and occupancy queries are hostel-scoped today and need widening.

Cross-reference: LODGY-72 adds a vacancy filter to this same screen, driven from the Home tile. Design the hostel filter and the fill filter together - two separately-conceived filter rows on one screen will not sit well, and both need to feed the LODGY-67 summary row consistently.
